title: fix(mcp): preserve transcription usage in MCP tool results
author: ale-rls

gist.summary: MCP audio transcription results now keep the transcript as the first text block and append the gateway's unchanged usage data as a second, JSON-formatted text block. Clients can read metered duration alongside the transcript; a regression test covers both blocks.
